title: 上海高考高分翻译背诵-121-25二模

items.zh: 我表姐每次旅行回来,都会买一些有当地特色的纪念品。
items.en: Every time my cousin returns from a trip, she picks up some locally characteristic souvenirs.

items.zh: 如今,有些年轻人为了能够自由支配时间,选择灵活就业。
items.en: Nowadays, some young people opt for flexible work to enjoy the freedom to manage their own time.

items.zh: 毋庸置疑,我们不可过度依赖人工智能,而应善用其作为工具,辅助我们的生活、学习和工作。
items.en: Undoubtedly, we should use AI as a tool to assist us in our daily lives, studies and work instead of relying heavily on it.

items.zh: 为抵御台风来袭,志愿者们正顶风冒雨,挨家挨户提醒居民把盆栽搬入室内。
items.en: To guard against the coming typhoon, the volunteers are, regardless of wind and rain, going from door to door to remind residents to move their potted plants indoors.
